title: Read and toggle a schematic preference
summary: Reads a boolean option of the SCH server with ServerOptionsReader, writes the negated value with ServerOptionsWriter and asks the server module to reload its options through IServerOptions.ReloadOptions.
phrasings: change a schematic editor option from code
write a server option and reload it
turn off reset designators on paste

commands.name: ChangeSchPreference
commands.description: Toggle a boolean schematic preference and reload the SCH options; returns old and new value

commands.name: ReadSchPreference
commands.description: Show the current value of a boolean schematic preference (added read-back command)
